### Highlights

#### First-run setup now explains how the app actually works

A new walkthrough screen lays out the whole loop: League RPC waits in the tray doing nothing, wakes up when it sees the League client, and goes back to sleep when you close it. It also says plainly that it does not launch League for you, which is the thing most likely to look broken if you expect otherwise. The wording changes to match the settings you just picked, so if you left "start with Windows" off it tells you to launch it yourself, and that doing so mid-game works fine.

The same question is now in the FAQ too, since first-run setup only happens once. You can replay the walkthrough any time from Help.

#### Light mode reworked

The ground is darker and the surfaces sit above it properly, so panels read as panels instead of white on slightly-less-white. Borders are strong enough to actually see, accent tints and disabled states use the same token set as dark mode rather than being approximated, and every interactive element gets a visible focus ring in place of the browser default, which was near invisible on a light background.
